title: Zapqio Runner Protocol — v2
description: Schemas for the WebSocket messages exchanged between Zapqio Web (server) and a Runner (client). IMPORTANT: the envelope's `data` field is a STRING containing the JSON-encoded payload (double-encoding). These $defs describe the DECODED payloads; parse `data` as JSON before validating it against the payload schema matching `type`. See PROTOCOL.md.

message.title: Message — the envelope of every frame

data.title: JSON-encoded payload (double-encoded), or null
data.description: A JSON document encoded as a string. Decode it, then validate against: Info -> $defs/messageInfo; Job (web->runner) -> $defs/messageJob; JobAccepted -> $defs/messageJobAccepted; JobReturn -> $defs/messageJobReturn; Log -> $defs/messageLog. Null only for a Job poll (runner->web).

maxConcurrency.description: How many jobs the runner executes at once, i.e. how many unresolved jobs Web may keep at it (PROTOCOL.md §5.1, §5.2). Optional: a runner that omits it executes one job at a time. Web may cap the value.

in.description: JSON Schema of the method input, carried as a string. May be null.

out.description: JSON Schema of the method output, carried as a string. May be null.

attemptId.description: Identifies THIS dispatch. The same job id may be dispatched several times; attemptId differs each time. Echo it back unchanged in JobAccepted, every Log and JobReturn.

name.description: Method name to execute (matches a messageMethod.name).

data.description: Job input as a JSON string (matches the method's `in` schema). May be empty or null.

attemptId.description: The attemptId from the dispatch being acknowledged.
The attemptId from the dispatch this result belongs to.

data.description: On OK: job output as a JSON string (matches the method's `out` schema), which Web feeds to the next pipeline step. On ERROR it SHOULD be null; anything sent is kept on the failed attempt as a diagnostic note and is never passed on.

attemptId.description: The attemptId from the dispatch this entry belongs to.
